itthaṃ mokṣadvārapālaṃ śamākhyamādyamupavarṇya dvitīyaṃ vicāraṃ
varṇayiṣyan vasiṣṭha uvāca - śāstreti

tatrārthānarthānubandhavicāraḥ
sārāsāravicāro heyopādeyavicāraḥ pramāṇatātparyavicāraḥ ātmatattvaparīkṣā
ceti vicāraḥ pañcavidhaḥ

tatra svābhāvikapravṛtterviṣayāṇāṃ
cānarthānubandhitā śāstrīyapravṛttervairāgyādeśca
puruṣārthānubandhitetyanvayavyatirekādinā parīkṣātmaka ādyaḥ

mumukṣottaramapi mokṣasādhanaṃ karma
vopāsanameva vā te api kiṃ samuccite uta jñānasamuccite uta jñānameveti
parīkṣātmā tṛtīyaḥ

yadāpi jñānameva tadāpi tatkiṃ
sāṃkhyavaiśeṣikādyabhimataṃ kapilagautamoktatattachāstrapramāṇakaṃ
śrautameva vā yadāpi śrautaṃ tadāpi kiṃ śrutīnāṃ dvaite utādvaite saviśeṣe uta
nirviśeṣe ātmanyanātmani vā tātparyamiti parīkṣātmā caturthaḥ

śrutyādipramāṇānāmapyadvitīye saccidānandabrahmātmani
tātparyāvadhāraṇe'pi svātmani paramārthatastathātvaṃ saṃbhavati na veti
ratnaparīkṣānyāyenānubhavaniṣṭhagurusatīrthyādisaṃvādena
jīveśvarajagattattvapariśodhanena ca yāvadavadhāraṇaṃ parīkṣaṇātmā
pañcamaḥ

tatrādyānāṃ trayāṇāṃ phalaṃ sādhanacatuṣṭayasaṃpattiḥ
antyayostu kramātpramāṇaprameyāsaṃbhāvanānivṛttiḥ

tatrādyā yadyapi
bhāgyavaśataḥ svato'pi ca bhavanti tathāpi svapratyayadṛḍhīkārāya
punarguruśāstrapuraḥsaraṃ kartavyāḥ

antyau tu guruśāstrābhyāmeva bhavata iti
sarvasādhāraṇyena śāstrāvabodhāmalayā dhiyetyuktam

anantābhirīhābhiḥ pravṛttibhiḥ paritaḥ pallaviteva
rāgādibhirvivṛddhā ākṛtiḥ saṃniveśo yasya

bandhunāśādiṣu duḥkhasthāneṣu yaducitaṃ kartavyaṃ yena copāyena
duḥkhottaraṇaṃ cittasamādhānaṃ ca tatsarvaṃ mohena vaicittyena vyāptaṃ na
sphuratīti yāvat
viveko'tra vicārastena vikāsinyo yā matayastā na majjanti na viṣīdanti
mūrkhāṇāṃ hṛnmana eva kānanaṃ vanaṃ tatsthānām

puruṣārthaviṣaye
āśāṃ mumukṣāṃ prathamaṃ rundhanti tacchīlānām

mañjaryaḥ phalakośamañjaryo duḥkhavyavahārāḍambarabhūtāstā hi
sakaṇṭakāḥ kaṭukaphalagarbhāḥ prasiddhāḥ
mahatya āpado yeṣu te ca te atidīrghāśca teṣu
mānasaṃ mana eva sarastadeva himavatkukṣau prasiddhaṃ mānasaṃ saraḥ

candradaivatye candravadvivekaprakāśayogye ca manasi
candrikāsadṛśa jñānasukhāvirbhāva evocitastasmādyasya mūrkhasya
śokaduḥkhādyudbhavastasya candrādapyaśanirvajramudeti

yathā śiśorbālasya
maurkhyādyakṣaḥ prāguktavetāla udeti tadvat

nirviveko narādhamo duḥkhabījānāmeva nirantarabharaṇāya nirmitaṃ khaṇḍakaṃ
bhūkusulam

ekānte manuṣyāsevyasthāne vā
vidyamānena vanadrumeṇa sadharmāṇam

ata eva sādhūnāmadhvagānāṃ
chāyāśrayadānādikāryeṣu sādhuṣu puruṣārthopayogiṣu kāryeṣu
vā'kṣamamasamartham

bhuvanaṃ jalaṃ yathā tāpārtaṃ sarvaṃ janaṃ śītalayati
tṛṣārtaṃ ca alaṃ tṛptaṃ karoti tadvat

jantoradhikārijanmavataḥ puruṣasya
paramārthasyotkṛṣṭapuruṣārthalakṣaṇarājabhāvaprāpteḥ sūcakatvātpatākāyā
dhiyaḥ śuddhabuddheḥ saṃbandhivicāro dhavalacāmaramivāsādhāraṇaṃ
rājacihnaṃ rājate

jīvā vicāreṇaiva kramācāravo jīvanmuktabhūtāḥ santo bhūyasāṃ prāṇināṃ
vicāraprakāśena bhavabhayalakṣaṇaṃ tamo'paghnanto
nanu vicāreṇa bhayanivṛttiḥ kva dṛṣṭā tatrāha - bālasyeti

niśi
bahirgamanapratibandhārthaṃ kalpito vetālastathā saṃsāro vilīyate

astu tatra tathā prakṛte kathaṃ bhayanivṛttirityāśaṅkya bhayahetorjagato
vicāreṇa mithyātvanirṇayādityāha - sarva eveti

na bhayanivṛttireva kiṃtu niratiśayānandāvāptirapi tatphalamityāha -
samamiti

tena vicāreṇa prakaṭasyābhogasya
niratiśayānandasya tejasā sāmarthyena cāñcalyahetvajñāne naṣṭe acalasthititayā
udārā ānandapūrṇatālakṣaṇā niṣkāmatā udeti

acalasthitirevottamatvaṃ tatpradayā pūrvoktayā vicāralakṣaṇayā mahauṣadhyā
siddhaḥ puruṣo nābhivāñchatyaprāptaṃ prāptaṃ ca nojjhati

na suṣuptāvivopādhiśāntyā śāmyati nāpi svapnavadāntaravāsanāmaye nimajjati
na vā mūḍhajanajāgradvadbahye'vasannastiṣṭhati
arṇavapakṣe gataṃ lakṣmīkaustubhādivastu upekṣate na tatprāptyai yatate
ihāsmiñśarīra evānubhūyamāno jīvabrahmaikyalakṣaṇo yogo yeṣāmasti te

kāryo'vaśyakartavyaḥ saṃkaṭeṣvarthakṛcchreṣu saṃdihyata iti saṃdehaḥ
saṃdhivigrahādistaṃ jānāti niścinoti

vedānāṃ karmakāṇḍānāṃ vedāntānāṃ ca siddhāntasthitayo
dharmabrahmatattvalakṣaṇāstātparyaviśrāntibhūmayaḥ sthiteḥ
puruṣārthapratiṣṭhāyāḥ kāraṇaṃ prāpikā iti yāvat

prasiddhalocanamandhakāre naṣṭamiva bahutejaḥsu sūryādiṣu jihmitaṃ pratihataṃ
vyavahitaviprakṛṣṭagrahaṇeṣvasamarthaṃ ca vicāralakṣaṇaṃ locanaṃ tu na
tathetyarthaḥ

viveko vicāra ātmeva priyaḥ pradhāno vā yasya sa puruṣo divyacakṣurjayati
abhibhavatyāpado vināśayati prāpnoti vā puruṣārtham

udaramantaraṃ
kurute atha tasya bhayaṃ bhavati iti śruteḥ

sā hānistanmahāchidraṃ sāndhatā sā
ca mūkatā

yatkṣaṇaṃ vā muhūrta vā śivamekaṃ na cintayet iti
laiṅgavacanācceti bhāvaḥ

viṣaśastradhātādyanarthaśatairjarjaraḥ śithilāṅgo'pi tathā naca rauti yathā
avicāreṇa vinaṣṭo vināśitaprāya ātmā yena so'jñaḥ parito janmaparamparāsu
roditi

saṃsāraḥ kathaṃ kena hetunā adhiṣṭhāne āgata iti
tatpadārthavicāraḥ

ṭaṅkacchedādikaṣṭaniṣpādyatvādduṣṭāya khāya cchidrāyaiva ca kṛtaṃ
dhātrā

andho
hyadṛṣṭvā kūpe patati manastu dṛṣṭvāpi mohānnarakeṣvapi patatīti

athavā yo durmatiravicārī ca puruṣastasya hṛdayaṃ
śilāyāḥ sakāśāt kṛtamityutprekṣā

bhāvaḥ satyastasya graha upādānaṃ abhāvo'styastasyotsargastyāgastau paśyatāṃ
prekṣāvatāmiha vyavahārabhūmau sādhu samyak tattvaṃ vicāraṃ vinā na jñāyate

yataḥ sarvopi janaḥ
sphuṭavicāradṛśaiva laukikavaidikakarmaṇāṃ saphalatāṃ phalate niṣpādayati
ātmatattvasya uttamāṃ vakṣyamāṇasaptamabhūmikāṃtāmutkṛṣyamāṇāṃ
prakaṭatāṃ ca gācchati prāpnoti
